field_test.name: NASA JETT5 Artemis III field test
field_test.where: San Francisco Volcanic Field, northern Arizona
field_test.summary: NASA's Joint EVA and Human Surface Mobility Test Team Field Test 5 rehearsed Artemis III moonwalks in the San Francisco Volcanic Field; some EVAs ran at night to test a variety of lighting conditions, because the lighting at the lunar south pole is dynamic.
